_meta.description: Universal resilience guidance for code that crosses process, network, IO, or tool boundaries.

principles.label: Keep failure boundaries explicit
principles.rationale: External boundaries fail in ways local code does not; explicit failure handling keeps agent patches auditable.
principles.directive_hint: When touching external IO, preserve or add explicit timeout, error handling, and observable failure reporting.

principles.label: Do not hide unknown state
principles.rationale: SAGE should say what it knows and what it does not know; silent fallback weakens trust in downstream decisions.
principles.directive_hint: If a fallback is used, preserve a visible status, warning, or telemetry trail.
